title: Pretty and Pathetic
text: Pretty and Pathetic. In the broad daylight this tree is pathetic. Cheaply made and the branches are wrapped in plastic strips.  But you know what they say. Most things look better in the dark. Actually then it's kind of pretty. Comes with the top all bent over to fit the box so it requires a whole lot of messing with to get it into tree shape. Probably best to hide it in the daylight or it could scare the kids.

product_metadata.title: Vanthylit Easter Tree with Timer Battery Operated, Light up Indoor Spring Decorations, Centerpiece Table Decorations for Home Décor, White Easter Tree Gifts for Kids (2FT, Warm White)
features: Spring Decorations for Home: 2FT lighted birch tree with 24 led warm white lights, bright and inviting, attached with lovely items like bunnies, butterflies, and ladybugs to make it the most whimsical decoration on your spring holiday.
Easter Tree with Timer: On/off/timer switch button on the base with automatically 6-hour on and 18-hour off timer, can be left on to your convenience, greatly saving your time.
Battery Powered: White Easter birch tree operated by 3 AA batteries (not included), button on its mossy flowery base, no worried about where the socket is, just press and enjoy your springtime.

Flexible and Bendable Branches: Twigs of this tabletop tree can be bent around in different ways to your preference and can be hanging with some lightweight accessories that you like. Created by hand, it is a festive way to commemorate your Easter decor with your family and friends.

Wide Application: Ideal party centerpiece for any Easter celebration, quickly infuse your environment with a sense of springtime. Green felt along the base and partway up the tree's trunk that looks just like moss growing up it, perfect for your family table or as a present for friends and neighbors.
